commit.message:
fix: respect host parameter from config when running CLI

- Add --host CLI option to allow overriding host from command line
- Update start_server_with_args() to accept and use host parameter
- Fix CLI to pass host from config or command line to server
- Update URL construction to use configured host instead of hardcoded localhost
- Add host examples to help text

Fixes issue where host config setting was ignored and server always bound to 127.0.0.1

commit.message: Update Docs links and CLI reference

Add Windows support using winloop as uvloop alternative

- Add winloop>=0.1.8 dependency for Windows (sys_platform=='win32')
- Keep uvloop>=0.17.0 for non-Windows platforms
- Implement cross-platform event loop policy selection in cli.py
- Add graceful fallback to default asyncio event loop if imports fail
- Resolves Windows compatibility issues with uvloop not supporting Windows
